*Deleted or broke something? Help → SwiftMind Help reinstalls a fresh copy.*
SwiftMind is a native macOS mind-mapping app. Your maps are plain `.swiftmind.html` files — they open read-only in any browser, no app required.

text: ⌘N new map · ⌘O open · File → Open Recent

markdown:
**My Brain** is a mind-map view of your folders.

- Add Vault… registers any folder (security-scoped)
- Double-click a map node to open it
- Double-click a folder to fold/unfold it
- Default library: `~/Documents/SwiftMind`

text: ⌘, Settings: launch behavior, vaults, agent bridge
Toolbar: switch canvas ⇄ outline, both stay in sync
Drag a node onto another to reparent
Double-click a title to rename; a markdown node opens the note on the node
⇧⌘P pins a node · Option+drag places it freely

markdown: Auto layout positions everything for you. **Pin** a node to freeze its spot; **Option+drag** moves the pin; **Unpin** hands it back to auto layout.

Paste is smart:

- Markdown bullets → nested nodes
- A URL → a link node
- An image → embedded in the note
- HTML from other apps → plain text

Every paste is one undo step.

text: Drop text, URLs, images or files right onto the canvas
Arrows or hjkl move spatially · f = follow mode

markdown: `j`/`k` walk siblings, `h`/`l` follow the branch inward/outward. Press `f` and the canvas keeps the active node centered as you navigate. `Esc` clears focus.

text: ⌘K command palette: every action + jump to node
Bookmark nodes, jump back from the sidebar
Double-click — rename a title, or edit markdown on the node
E — note beside node · ⌘E / double-click markdown — edit on node · ⌥⌘E — expand card
f — follow mode · Esc — clear focus

text: Or edit notes in the inspector sidebar

markdown: The three tasks below carry a `status` attribute. Type `status=done` into the sidebar **Filter** field to see filtering in action — switch between **Hide** and **Highlight**.

text: Named styles + conditional rules in the inspector
Icons: check, flag, star, warning, idea, todo…
Links: open a web page or jump across the map

markdown: This node has two links (see the inspector): a web page about mind mapping, and a **node link** that jumps straight to the formula demo.

A small, safe expression DSL — never arbitrary code. Results are **derived**: they recompute live and are never stored in the file.

Broken formula? You get `#ERR: reason` inline, nothing crashes.

DSL: `attr("cost")`, `sum|avg|min|max(children, attr: "cost")`, `count(children)`, `progress()`, arithmetic, comparisons, `and/or/not`, `if(c, t, e)`.

text: Edit a cost value — watch the badge update
swiftmind CLI: read, find, batch-edit map files

markdown: `swiftmind read map.swiftmind.html` prints the map as JSON; `batch` applies JSON ops all-or-nothing; edits are refused if the file changed on disk in between. The app hot-reloads external changes.

text: swiftmind mcp: agents drive the live app

markdown: A local Unix-socket bridge (no network) lets an AI agent read and edit the map you have open — as **one undo step** per batch. Toggle it in Settings (⌘,) → Agent.

text: Bulk actions: restyle every filter match at once

markdown: Scripts use the `mindmap` API to record *intents* — applied as one undoable batch only if the script finishes cleanly. No network, file, or process access exists inside the sandbox.

text: Maps are plain HTML — double-click one, it opens in your browser
Sandboxed: no network, only files you choose
